articles.summary: Ford gained retail share and delivered strong truck and large SUV results in the third quarter of 2026, led by stronger F-Series sales in September and Super Duty’s best quarterly production performance in 19 years.
articles.title: Ford Builds Q3 Momentum with Retail Share Gains, Strong Truck and Large SUV Performance

articles.summary: A win for Oracle Red Bull Racing this weekend at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia marks the debut win for the Red Bull Ford Powertrain in only its 16th race. A monumental achievement for Red Bull Ford Powertrains who have developed an F1 race-winning power unit from scratch in a short space of time. As technology partners of Oracle Red Bull Racing and official powertrain partner of Red Bull Ford Powertrains, Ford Racing is proud to celebrate this outstanding result.
articles.title: A New Winning Chapter for Ford and Red Bull Ford Powertrains
